brief: The Vetāla seated on a root reciting from memory with one finger raised, a faint glow of old palm-leaf lines in the air above him; Lubdhaka, tall and arms folded, sneering at the edge of the lamplight; you, Dādī and Śuka listening.
The Vetāla seated on a root holding up a palm-leaf scroll with one finger on a line; a small basket of fruit at his feet; Dādī and Śuka beside you reading along; firelight.

A flat stone in the grove with the Vetāla opening a worn ledger; a small round honey-brown spirit with ten tiny brass-handled drawers in his body hopping out and tugging drawers open, a pencil behind his ear; you, Dādī and Śuka watching; firelight.
A small spirit emerging from an open drawer, bowing and handing an apple to you, with two more apples in its other hand; Dhātuka beside it ticking a list; Dādī laughing; Śuka eyeing an apple.
